title: Inventory Value for a day after release counts a bin below zero
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day after this release, date A, at a cost of $10.00, with 0 in its only bin.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line on date A while its bin holds 0, so part A ended date A at -2 and the report saved that figure for date A.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Set the as-of date to date A.
  3. Type part A's part number in the report's Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • The report shows date A.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed for date A with Qty -2.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost -$20.00 (-2 × $10.00), and the Totals row reads Qty -2.00 and Total Cost -$20.00.
  • The row is not left out and does not read 0.00 or $0.00: the figures saved for a date from release on count the bin below zero.
